cause: For a Creature's control seat, a new Player could have a pending join while the vehicle still had a different charmer GUID. Execute cancelled seat/passenger requests, published pointer/seat, changed count/movement flags and dismissed the pet before SetCharmedBy rejected the existing charmer. Its false return escaped EventProcessor deletion and left partial boarding. A second pending passenger could also be cancelled by the failed attempt. Pinned30d6a929 reproduces this controlled state, including equal-low/different-high identities; no observed client failure or live ownership conflict is claimed.
repair: After ordinary world/kit/aura/usable-count admission, read the live charmer only for Creature target + actual Player passenger + CAN_CONTROL seat. A nonempty full GUID DIFFERENT from that passenger emits the same existing fatal format/category/severity, calls native Abort(eventTime) and finishes true BEFORE pending cancellation/publication/count/pet/charm effects. Keep original Unit::SetCharmedBy untouched, including its later validation and diagnostics. Empty/same-owner, non-control and non-Player contexts bypass this extra fence. Do not substitute Owner/GetAnyOwner, group leadership or low-GUID comparison; do not clear or steal the other controller, repair counters or grant progression.
